slots.name: affected companies
slots.sentence: One of the Trump administration’s pilot to test lowering U.S. drug prices by tying them to costs abroad, called the GLOBE model initially impacts just three pharmaceutical companies

slots.name: savings reduction
slots.sentence: a 96 percent reduction from the proposed version, which estimated nearly $12 billion in savings over the same period.

slots.name: Part B threshold
slots.sentence: To qualify for GLOBE, a drug must account for more than $100 million in traditional Medicare Part B spending per year.

slots.name: targeted spending
slots.sentence: The final version of the model only covers a handful of drugs; Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) now estimates that less than 1 percent of eligible Part B drug spending is initially targeted by GLOBE.

slots.name: projected savings
slots.sentence: It’s now estimated that the GLOBE model will save $440 million over seven years

slots.name: proposed savings
slots.sentence: which estimated nearly $12 billion in savings over the same period.

slots.name: implementation status
slots.sentence: The Trump administration rolled out the final version of a new Medicare payment model aimed at lowering the prices of drugs administered in doctors’ offices to match those paid in countries overseas.
